description.value: Founded in 2003, Izumiya is a 100% BC-owned Japanese marketplace spanning over 10,000 sq ft of dry and frozen goods, housewares, cosmetics, and appliances imported directly from Japan. The in-house kitchen prepares fresh bento boxes, sushi, and ready-to-eat foods daily, and the store also offers online ordering for pickup and catering trays. Bilingual staff assist in both Japanese and English, making it Richmond's go-to destination for authentic Japanese groceries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for izumiya.ca is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number, address, and category. Basic groceries and hot/fresh food (bento boxes, sushi, and ready-to-eat items prepared daily in an in-house kitchen) are confirmed by multiple website pages. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Mo-Sa 10:00-20:00, Su 10:00-19:00) and the website's stated hours (10:30 AM–6:00 PM daily), flagged in concerns.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM tags list Mo-Sa 10:00-20:00 and Su 10:00-19:00 (check_date 2025-12-27), but the website consistently states 10:30 AM–6:00 PM daily across all pages. Recommend verifying current hours directly with the business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating Japanese grocery and fresh-food marketplace in Richmond; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists seeking groceries and ready-to-eat meals.

Hot food.detail: In-house kitchen prepares fresh bento boxes, sushi, and ready-to-eat foods daily; catering trays and online pickup orders also available
